about_the_game:
The original soundtrack for Nullstar: Solus composed by Alec Shea.

Featuring performances from Amelia Jones (Vocals), Mariya Anastasova (Vocals)

Tracklist:
1 - Orbital Limbo (ft. Amelia Jones)
2 - The Labyrinth of Steel Veins

3 - Cavorite Womb

4 - Eater of Falling Stars

5 - Breath of a Sterile Beast (ft. Mariya Anastasova)

6 - Ouroboros Paradigm

7 - Labyrinth of the Steel Heart (ft. Tom Howard)

8 - Cavorite Viscera (ft. 88bit)

9 - Devourer of Shifting Galaxies (ft. Masahiro Aoki)

10 - Bones of a Barren Whale (ft. Takahiro Obata, Mariya Anastasova)

11 - Ouroboros Genesis (ft. Atlan)
